title: AI Adoption framework
description: Designed an AI adoption framework for a B2B SaaS company — translating AI capabilities into practical operator workflows across growth, marketing, and product. Built for responsible, compounding AI use.
problem: The team wanted to add AI but had no framework for evaluating where it creates real leverage vs. where it creates noise.
system: Adoption playbook: use-case prioritization, workflow redesign for AI-assisted execution, tooling decisions, and a rollout model that keeps humans in the loop where it matters.
artifact: Structured adoption framework with prioritized use cases, prompt templates, and operating guidelines.
outcome: Clearer AI roadmap, team alignment on where AI creates compounding value across growth and product.
